```{r setup}
require(dplyr)
require(nnet)
```

## Load data + train/test split

```{r}
data = read.csv("02_llm/bills_prompts_responses_10000.csv")

data = data %>%
  mutate(
    Senate = as.integer(Chamber == 1), # 0: House, 1: Senate
    Democrat = as.integer(Party == 100), # 100: Democrat; 200: Republican, 328: Independent
    # label = as.integer(label == "True"),
    Major = relevel(as.factor(Major), ref = 20),
    Postal = as.factor(Postal),
    Model = as.factor(Model)
  )

# split data into train/test set
set.seed(123)
train_idx = sample(x=nrow(data), size=floor(0.7 * nrow(data)))
train = data[train_idx, ]
test = data[-train_idx, ]
```

## Multinomial Logisitic Regression

Currently, we use Major topic 20 as a reference level. 

```{r}
# get f* models for each feature V
train$Major2 = relevel(train$Major, ref = 20)

model_unres = multinom(Major2 ~ 1, data=train)
# summary(model_unres)

model_res_chamber = multinom(Major2 ~ Senate, data = train)
# summary(model_res_chamber)

anova(model_unres, model_res_chamber)
```
